sections.title: IHE IT Infrastructure Technical Framework Supplement — Privacy Consent on FHIR (PCF)
Overview and Bibliographic Identity
sections.extract: The IHE IT Infrastructure Technical Framework Supplement: Privacy Consent on FHIR (PCF) specifies how patient privacy consent directives are recorded, discovered, maintained, and enforced over HL7 FHIR resources using the FHIR Consent resource and RESTful transactions. Actors and Transactions (§1:53.1)
sections.extract: PCF defines three primary actors for privacy consent management and enforcement: Actor; Role in PCF; CapabilityStatement Canonical Consent Recorder; Captures, updates, and revokes patient privacy consent directives on behalf of a patient or authorized representative and submits them to a Consent Registry via [ITI-108] Access Consent.; https://profiles.ihe.net/ITI/PCF/CapabilityStatement/IHE.PCF.consentRecorder

sections.title: Implicit Base Policy Sets (§1:53.2.1)
sections.extract: A FHIR Consent resource under PCF refines an underlying organizational or jurisdictional privacy policy identified in Consent.policy.uri. PCF organizes consent expressiveness into four progressive profile levels corresponding to the implicit base policy set (Consent.provision.type): Profile Level; StructureDefinition Canonical; Semantics Basic Consent;

sections.title: Scope and Interaction Model
sections.extract: Transaction Access Consent [ITI-108] is used by a Consent Recorder to create, update, delete, read, or search Consent resources held on a Consent Registry, and by a Consent Authorization Server (or composite data-sharing actor such as a VHL Sharer) to query active Consent directives for a patient prior to disclosing health information.

sections.title: Message Semantics (§2:3.108.4)
sections.extract: [ITI-108] uses the HL7 FHIR RESTful API over HTTPS: Create (POST [base]/Consent): Creates a new Consent resource conforming to IHE.PCF.consentBasic, IHE.PCF.consentIntermediate, or IHE.PCF.consentAdvanced. When submitted inside a FHIR transaction Bundle alongside a Provenance resource (IHE.PCF.provenance), records who captured the consent directive and how it was attested. sections.title: Required Elements on PCF Consent Profiles
sections.extract: Every PCF Consent instance (IHE.PCF.consentBasic, IHE.PCF.consentIntermediate, IHE.PCF.consentAdvanced) constrains the FHIR Consent resource as follows: Consent.status (1..1): draft | active | inactive | entered-in-error (proposed and rejected are prohibited in active enforcement).
